title: Samsung India mobile head Raju Antony Pullan resigns after 18 years
desc: Raju Antony Pullan, head of Samsung India's mobile phone business, has resigned. Pullan, a senior vice president, served the company for 18 years. He was responsible for sales, marketing, and all smartphone business functions. The Korean giant has not yet announced his successor. Samsung faces pressure in the mobile market, having lost leadership to Chinese brands.
